$comment: What flowapi holds itself to against the other generators. `cargo run --release --bin check` reads results/speed.json and fails on any rule a run breaks. A ratio is the best other tool's figure over flowapi's on each description; `except` lowers it for one description, where the measurement says less. Change a number only together with its reason, in the change that moves it.

rules.about: flowapi's output type-checks on every description, with tsc --strict --exactOptionalPropertyTypes.
flowapi, the whole process timed, is at least 10x faster than the fastest other generator on every description.
flowapi's peak resident memory is no more than the leanest other generator's on every description.
